title: BaseScheduler has no __repr__, so scheduled parameters print as bare values
body:
Sampler reprs render scheduler-backed parameters through get_scheduled_value, so a scheduled step_size is indistinguishable from a constant one: LangevinDynamics(model, step_size=CosineScheduler(0.1, 0.001, 100)) prints step_size=0.1.

Done when: BaseScheduler subclasses render their own configuration, sampler reprs show it for scheduled parameters, and a test distinguishes a constant from a schedule.
